title: Repair Telegram catalog resolver integration contract
requirements: Repair the resolver to consume the actual reviewed ReadCatalog projection key catalog_version, never the invented key version. Require catalog_version as a non-boolean integer in 1..2147483647 and keep every existing catalog/service/option validation. A mapping with only version must return CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE. Add a realistic synthetic projection matching PublicCatalogRuntime output, including catalog_version, club_timezone, contact_info, location_link, visit_rules and services, and prove service resolution against it.

Treat TelegramIntent as untrusted construction. Require its payload to be the exact immutable mappingproxy type produced by TelegramInteractionMapper. Direct OPEN/HELP/RESET/SUBMIT require empty payload. TEXT_INPUT requires exactly {text} with normalized non-empty string up to 4096 characters and callback_query_id absent, then returns SCREEN_REQUIRED. SELECT_SERVICE requires exact numeric payload plus a present normalized callback_query_id and matching live catalog. Reject mutable mappings, malformed text payloads, SELECT_SERVICE without callback id, extra/missing fields and inconsistent shapes as INVALID_INTENT before reading the catalog.

Preserve all TG-007 safe error, ordering, active option, duplicate, ordinal, version, non-mutation and exact ChannelAction behavior. Add direct tests for the actual catalog_version projection, wrong legacy version key, mutable/forged payloads, valid and malformed TEXT_INPUT, SELECT_SERVICE callback-id presence, and proof invalid intents do not touch an exploding catalog mapping.

Copy this exact contract from primary .pipeline/TG-008-spec.json to tasks/specs/TG-008.json. Do not modify API/catalog producers, call Gateway/Conversation, or add copy, transport, HTTP, SDK, persistence, environment, logging, delivery, retry or external behavior.
acceptance: A service callback resolves against the actual ReadCatalog representation and rejects stale, malformed or forged intent/catalog input before action dispatch.
Only immutable mapper-produced intent shapes cross into ChannelAction resolution.
Focused resolver tests, interaction/update regressions, complete project tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Required integration and trust-shape repair before the catalog resolver can drive the shared conversation.
